evals.name: heart-chapter-recall
evals.prompt: Run the novel-nsfw-tagger on the sample novel 放开那个女巫 and verify that all chapters marked with ❤ in the title are tagged as NSFW. The gold standard is 116 ❤ chapters that must all be detected.
evals.expected_output: All 116 ❤ chapters have is_nsfw=true in the summary JSON, and nsfw_ratio >= 5 for each.

evals.name: weapon-chapter-false-positive
evals.prompt: Verify that known clean chapters (weapon/military themes like 第0073章火炮试射) are NOT tagged as NSFW. These chapters have keywords like 射 and 操 in non-sexual (firearm) contexts.
evals.expected_output: Chapter 0073 has is_nsfw=false in the summary JSON.

assertions.name: weapon_chapter_not_tagged
assertions.description: ch0073 (火炮试射) not tagged NSFW

evals.name: output-format-correctness
evals.prompt: Verify the tagged output file contains proper annotations: title lines modified with (nsfw XX), and <nsfw_start/>/<nsfw_end/> markers present inline.
evals.expected_output: At least one title line contains (nsfw XX) format, and <nsfw_start/> and <nsfw_end/> markers appear in tagged chapters.

evals.name: cross-novel-consistency
evals.prompt: Run the tagger on 月老 novel (known adult content) and verify a high proportion of chapters are tagged NSFW.
evals.expected_output: More than 200 chapters tagged NSFW (novel is primarily adult content).

evals.name: encoding_detection
evals.prompt: Verify that the tagger correctly detects UTF-16LE encoding for the main sample novel and produces valid output.
evals.expected_output: Encoding detected as UTF-16LE or produces correct line count ~92277.

assertions.name: encoding_detected_correctly
assertions.description: Encoding detection works for UTF-16LE novels
